title: Spicy Korean-Style Lentil Dosirak
description: A flavorful, spicy Korean-inspired dosirak filled with sautéed lentils, vegetables, and a hint of sesame.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced carrots and zucchini and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add the brown lentils, gochujang, and gochugaru to the pan and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve the lentil mixture in a dosirak bowl and garnish with additional green onions if desired.
